errors.evidence: The sector for "Областен град" (Regional city) is red, not blue ("син сектор").

errors.text_span: който представлява 9,9% от общия брой отговори
errors.evidence: The chart does not display a percentage for the "Друг град" (Other city) slice. The value 9.9% is invented and numerically incorrect, as the sum of the remaining unlabeled slices must be 9.1% (100 - 81.8 - 9.1).

errors.text_span: и представляващ 1,2% от общия брой отговори
errors.evidence: The chart does not display a percentage for the "Село" (Village) slice. The value of 1.2% is invented.

errors.text_span: както и етикети с проценти, вписани директно в всеки съответен сектор
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that every sector has a percentage label. The sectors for "Друг град" (Other city) and "Село" (Village) do not have percentage labels.

errors.text_span: Няма визуален фокус върху определен сектор.
errors.evidence: This statement is inaccurate as the "Столица" (Capital city) sector at 81.8% is visually dominant and creates a clear focal point, which the description denies.
